messages:
maria_sales: Escalating Arcadia Retail POC — VP product (Khan) asked for a firm 99th-percentile latency SLA and they have unresolved items on the security questionnaire. Need exec sync + commitment on a Dedicated pool by tomorrow.

linda_cust_success: Customer here — Khan wants go/no-go by EOW, otherwise they may pause the POC.

ajay_se: Quick clarifying q: are they measuring 99th per-request (end-to-end) or per-token server-side? What's the numeric target? Also do they require private deployment or will a Dedicated hosted pool be OK?

sara_security: Security status: SOC2 checklist — two open items: (1) cross-region audit log retention (we default to 90d, they want 365d), (2) segmentation proof for third-party connectors. I can provide a segmentation attestation doc; retention needs product/ops signoff.

devon_re: Pricing note — reserving 4x A100s for a POC will affect the deal economics. I can approve a short-term promotional discount if we get exec approval. Need exact GPU count + duration to model.

ajay_se: For latency verification we can run a synthetic workload. Proposed plan: reserve Dedicated pool, run 10k requests with p95/p99 measurement. Reserve command (ops): `rictl reserve --pool=arcadia-poc --gpus=4 --duration=72h`

ops-bot: reservation created — pool: arcadia-poc, gpus: 4xA100, expires: 2026-06-15T09:00:00Z.

sara_security: I'll draft the segmentation attestation + questionnaire responses and post by EOD. Legal — retention is policy, can we get a one-time exception for this POC?

maria_sales: @devon_re can you escalate pricing ask to @raj_exec? We need approval to offer ~25% off for a 3-week POC. Also requesting @raj_exec to join a customer call tomorrow 9:00am PT.

raj_exec: I can join 9:00am PT. Devon, send me expected ARR uplift if we convert after POC so I can sign off on the promo. Maria — schedule and include the questionnaire and test plan.

devon_re: Expected ARR if successful: approx $420k ARR (annualized). I'll prep a 1-pager with sensitivity scenarios.

linda_cust_success: Customer confirmed 9:00am PT works. I'll send calendar invite and dial-in.

maria_sales: Action items recap: 1) ops reservation = done. 2) sara to post questionnaire responses by EOD. 3) devon to create pricing memo and send to @raj_exec. 4) ajay to run synthetic latency tests and share p95/p99 by noon PT tomorrow. If anyone sees a blocker, flag now. :thumbsup:

ajay_se: Running the synthetic test once pool is live. Will post commands and results to this thread.

sara_security: Legal flagged retention as a policy decision — @legal_team, can we get a one-time retention exception for Arcadia POC if Product and Security approve the compensating controls? I'll attach the questionnaire link.

legal_team: Reviewing now. We need explicit risk acknowledgment from Security and Product; if they provide an audit plan and attestation we can sign off conditionally for the POC period.

maria_sales: Thanks everyone. I'll post a summary in #sales-updates after the call and include action-item owners.
